customer_question: On the SIG registration Review Page, does the product name need to be entered using half-width (single-byte) characters, even if it was originally typed with full-width characters?
question_variants: Why was our product name changed from a full-width form to a half-width form on the Review Page?
Does the registration form require ASCII/half-width characters for the product name field?
Is a full-width digit or full-width space in the product name acceptable for SIG registration?
What formatting corrections are needed before confirming the Review Page registration?
actual_issue: The product name submitted for the SIG registration Review Page contained full-width (2-byte) characters - a full-width digit instead of a half-width digit, and a full-width space instead of a half-width space - which are not acceptable for the registration's product name field and needed correction before the customer could confirm the registration.
plain_english_explanation: When typing in Japanese, it's easy to accidentally use 'full-width' versions of numbers, letters, and spaces (common in Japanese word processing) instead of the standard 'half-width' (regular ASCII) versions. The Bluetooth SIG registration form requires the product name to be entered using standard half-width characters only. Before the registration can be finalized, any full-width characters in the product name need to be replaced with their half-width equivalents.
consultant_answer: The consultant identified that the submitted product name contained a full-width digit in place of a half-width digit, and a full-width (2-byte) space in place of a half-width space, both of which need to be entered using single-byte alphanumeric code on the registration confirmation form. The consultant corrected the product name to use the half-width digit and half-width space and resubmitted the Review Page for the customer's confirmation. The customer confirmed there was only one product type to register and approved the corrected entry.
decision_logic: Product name fields on the SIG registration Review Page must use half-width (single-byte) ASCII characters. If the source text was typed via a Japanese input method, any full-width digits, letters, or spaces embedded in the product name must be identified and converted to their half-width equivalents before the registration is confirmed.
final_recommendation: Before confirming a Review Page registration, check the product name field for full-width (zenkaku) characters - especially digits and spaces that may have been introduced via Japanese IME input - and convert them to half-width (hankaku) equivalents.
risk_if_done_wrong: If the registration were confirmed with full-width characters left in the product name, the listed product name could be recorded incorrectly (e.g., with non-standard characters), requiring a correction and re-confirmation of the Review Page after the fact.
